no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Lead candidate LPT-CBD (liposomal cannabidiol) is in pre-IND/preclinical stage. Per Feb 2026 FDA CVM fee waiver and ongoing CMC work, IND filing for human Phase 1 chronic pain study is targeted but not yet submitted. The published 2026 efficacy/PK study was conducted in dogs (veterinary). No active human Phase 1/2/3 trials.
